+/* 单写者互斥锁与串口环形队列静态存储 */
+static volatile boot_writer_t s_active_writer = BOOT_WRITER_NONE;
+static volatile uint8_t s_rx_ring[BOOT_UART2_RX_RING_SIZE];
+static volatile uint16_t s_rx_head = 0U;
+static volatile uint16_t s_rx_tail = 0U;

+static uint8_t s_frame_buf[MINIMC_MAX_FRAME_SIZE];
+static uint16_t s_frame_idx = 0U;

+/**
+  * @brief  计算标准 IEEE 802.3 CRC32 (Poly=0xEDB88320, Init=0xFFFFFFFF)
+  */
+uint32_t boot_crc32_ieee(const uint8_t *p_data, uint32_t length)
+{
+  if (p_data == NULL && length > 0U)
+  {
+    return 0U;
+  }
+
+  uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFUL;
+  for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < length; i++)
+  {
+    crc ^= (uint32_t)p_data[i];
+    for (uint8_t bit = 0U; bit < 8U; bit++)
+    {
+      if ((crc & 1UL) != 0UL)
+      {
+        crc = (crc >> 1U) ^ 0xEDB88320UL;
+      }
+      else
+      {
+        crc >>= 1U;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return ~crc;
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  计算 CRC16-CCITT (Poly=0x1021, Init=0xFFFF)
+  */
+uint16_t boot_crc16_ccitt(const uint8_t *p_data, uint32_t length)
+{
+  if (p_data == NULL && length > 0U)
+  {
+    return 0U;
+  }
+
+  uint16_t crc = 0xFFFFU;
+  for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < length; i++)
+  {
+    crc ^= (uint16_t)((uint16_t)p_data[i] << 8U);
+    for (uint8_t bit = 0U; bit < 8U; bit++)
+    {
+      if ((crc & 0x8000U) != 0U)
+      {
+        crc = (uint16_t)((crc << 1U) ^ 0x1021U);
+      }
+      else
+      {
+        crc = (uint16_t)(crc << 1U);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return crc;
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  校验 128 字节 ATSG Trailer 结构体合法性 (魔数、版本、Board ID、净荷上限与自身 CRC32)
+  */
+int boot_verify_trailer_struct(const fw_trailer_t *p_trailer,
+                               uint32_t expected_board_id,
+                               uint32_t max_payload_len)
+{
+  if (p_trailer == NULL)
+  {
+    return -1;
+  }
+  if (p_trailer->magic != TRAILER_MAGIC_ATSG)
+  {
+    return -2;
+  }
+  if (p_trailer->struct_ver != TRAILER_STRUCT_VER_V1)
+  {
+    return -3;
+  }
+  if (p_trailer->board_id != expected_board_id)
+  {
+    return -4;
+  }
+  if (p_trailer->payload_len == 0U || p_trailer->payload_len > max_payload_len)
+  {
+    return -5;
+  }
+
+  uint32_t calc_crc = boot_crc32_ieee((const uint8_t *)p_trailer, TRAILER_HEADER_CRC_SIZE);
+  if (calc_crc != p_trailer->trailer_crc32)
+  {
+    return -6;
+  }
+  return 0;
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  尝试获取单写者互斥锁 (USB U盘升级 vs USART2 串口升级)
+  */
+uint8_t boot_ota_acquire_writer(boot_writer_t writer)
+{
+  if (writer == BOOT_WRITER_NONE)
+  {
+    return 0U;
+  }
+  if (s_active_writer == BOOT_WRITER_NONE || s_active_writer == writer)
+  {
+    s_active_writer = writer;
+    return 1U;
+  }
+  return 0U;
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  释放单写者互斥锁
+  */
+void boot_ota_release_writer(boot_writer_t writer)
+{
+  if (s_active_writer == writer)
+  {
+    s_active_writer = BOOT_WRITER_NONE;
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  查询当前持有单写者互斥锁的通道
+  */
+boot_writer_t boot_ota_get_active_writer(void)
+{
+  return s_active_writer;
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  生成动态非零 boot_id (基于 UID 寄存器与上电盐值)
+  */
+static uint32_t derive_dynamic_boot_id(void)
+{
+  s_boot_salt += 0x9E3779B9UL;
+#ifndef HOST_UNIT_TEST
+  uint32_t uid0 = *(volatile uint32_t *)0x1FFFF7E8UL;
+  uint32_t uid1 = *(volatile uint32_t *)0x1FFFF7ECUL;
+  uint32_t uid2 = *(volatile uint32_t *)0x1FFFF7F0UL;
+  uint32_t rst = CRM->ctrlsts;
+  uint32_t id = uid0 ^ ((uid1 << 7U) | (uid1 >> 25U)) ^ uid2 ^ rst ^ s_boot_salt;
+#else
+  uint32_t id = 0x4350A55AUL ^ s_boot_salt;
+#endif
+  if (id == 0UL)
+  {
+    id = 0x43500001UL;
+  }
+  return id;
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  通过 USART2 发送指定长度字节流 (带超时保护)
+  */
+static void uart2_send_raw(const uint8_t *p_buf, uint16_t len)
+{
+  if (p_buf == NULL || len == 0U)
+  {
+    return;
+  }
+#ifndef HOST_UNIT_TEST
+  for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < len; i++)
+  {
+    uint32_t timeout = UART2_TX_TIMEOUT_LOOPS;
+    while (usart_flag_get(USART2, USART_TDBE_FLAG) == RESET && timeout > 0U)
+    {
+      timeout--;
+    }
+    usart_data_transmit(USART2, (uint16_t)p_buf[i]);
+  }
+  uint32_t tdc_timeout = UART2_TX_TIMEOUT_LOOPS;
+  while (usart_flag_get(USART2, USART_TDC_FLAG) == RESET && tdc_timeout > 0U)
+  {
+    tdc_timeout--;
+  }
+#else
+  host_mock_uart2_send_bytes(p_buf, len);
+#endif
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  组装并通过 USART2 发送一帧 MiniMCProto v2.0 响应 (MC -> AP)
+  */
+static void send_minimc_response(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req,
+                                 uint8_t rsp_cmd,
+                                 const uint8_t *p_payload,
+                                 uint16_t payload_len)
+{
+  if (p_req == NULL || payload_len > MINIMC_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE)
+  {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  minimc_frame_hdr_t hdr;
+  hdr.sof0 = MINIMC_SOF_0;
+  hdr.sof1 = MINIMC_SOF_1;
+  hdr.src_id = MINIMC_NODE_MC;
+  hdr.dst_id = p_req->src_id;
+  hdr.flags = (uint8_t)(MINIMC_FLAG_VERSION_V2 | MINIMC_FLAG_IS_RESPONSE);
+  hdr.cmd_id = rsp_cmd;
+  hdr.hop_limit = MINIMC_DEFAULT_HOP_LIMIT;
+  hdr.route_ctrl = 0U;
+  hdr.seq_id = p_req->seq_id;
+  hdr.payload_len = payload_len;
+
+  memcpy(s_tx_buf, &hdr, MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE);
+  if (payload_len > 0U && p_payload != NULL)
+  {
+    memcpy(&s_tx_buf[MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE], p_payload, payload_len);
+  }
+
+  uint16_t crc_pos = (uint16_t)(MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE + payload_len);
+  uint16_t crc = boot_crc16_ccitt(s_tx_buf, crc_pos);
+  s_tx_buf[crc_pos] = (uint8_t)(crc & 0xFFU);
+  s_tx_buf[crc_pos + 1U] = (uint8_t)((crc >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+
+  uart2_send_raw(s_tx_buf, (uint16_t)(crc_pos + MINIMC_CRC_SIZE));
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  发送标准 4 字节 0x00 CMD_ACK 应答帧
+  */
+static void send_ack(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req)
+{
+  minimc_payload_ack_t ack;
+  ack.planner_buf_free = 16U;
+  ack.rx_fifo_free_units = 2U;
+  ack.reserved = 0U;
+  send_minimc_response(p_req, MINIMC_CMD_ACK, (const uint8_t *)&ack, sizeof(ack));
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  发送标准 3 字节 0x06 CMD_NACK 错误应答帧
+  */
+static void send_nack(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req, uint8_t err_code)
+{
+  s_ota.last_error = err_code;
+  minimc_payload_nack_t nack;
+  nack.error_code = err_code;
+  nack.expected_seq = p_req->seq_id;
+  send_minimc_response(p_req, MINIMC_CMD_NACK, (const uint8_t *)&nack, sizeof(nack));
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x01 CMD_GET_VERSION 请求并回复 16B 0x02 CMD_VERSION_REPORT
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_get_version(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req)
+{
+  if (p_req->payload_len != 0U)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+  s_ota.stay_in_boot = 1U;
+  minimc_payload_version_report_t rep;
+  rep.proto_major = 2U;
+  rep.proto_minor = 0U;
+  rep.fw_major = 1U;
+  rep.fw_minor = 0U;
+  rep.boot_id = s_ota.boot_id;
+  rep.git_commit_short = MC_FW_GIT_COMMIT_SHORT;
+  rep.capability_flags = MC_BOOT_CAPABILITY_FLAGS;
+  send_minimc_response(p_req, MINIMC_CMD_VERSION_REPORT, (const uint8_t *)&rep, sizeof(rep));
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x03 CMD_PING 请求并回复 12B 0x04 CMD_PONG
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_ping(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req, const uint8_t *p_payload)
+{
+  if (p_req->payload_len != 4U || p_payload == NULL)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+  minimc_payload_pong_t pong;
+  memcpy(&pong.echo_token, p_payload, 4U);
+#ifndef HOST_UNIT_TEST
+  pong.uptime_ms = get_systick_ms();
+#else
+  pong.uptime_ms = host_mock_get_systick_ms();
+#endif
+  pong.rx_ok_count = s_ota.rx_ok_count;
+  pong.rx_crc_err_count = s_ota.rx_crc_err_count;
+  send_minimc_response(p_req, MINIMC_CMD_PONG, (const uint8_t *)&pong, sizeof(pong));
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x1D CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL (action: 1=Reboot, 2=JumpToBootloader)
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_system_control(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req,
+                                      const uint8_t *p_payload)
+{
+  if (p_payload == NULL || p_req->payload_len != sizeof(minimc_payload_sys_ctrl_t))
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  minimc_payload_sys_ctrl_t ctrl;
+  memcpy(&ctrl, p_payload, sizeof(ctrl));
+  if (ctrl.action == 2U)
+  {
+    s_ota.stay_in_boot = 1U;
+    send_ack(p_req);
+  }
+  else if (ctrl.action == 1U)
+  {
+    send_ack(p_req);
+    s_ota.pending_reboot = 1U;
+  }
+  else
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+  }
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x20 CMD_OTA_START (144B 擦除前 ATSG 准入校验与单写者加锁)
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_ota_start(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req,
+                                 const uint8_t *p_payload)
+{
+  if (g_upgrade_in_progress != 0U || boot_ota_acquire_writer(BOOT_WRITER_UART2) == 0U)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (p_payload == NULL || p_req->payload_len != sizeof(minimc_payload_ota_start_t))
+  {
+    boot_ota_release_writer(BOOT_WRITER_UART2);
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  minimc_payload_ota_start_t req;
+  memcpy(&req, p_payload, sizeof(req));
+  if (req.fw_size_bytes > MC_MAX_APP_SIZE || req.trailer.payload_len > MC_MAX_APP_SIZE)
+  {
+    boot_ota_release_writer(BOOT_WRITER_UART2);
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_OTA_IMAGE_OVERSIZE);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (req.target_device != MINIMC_NODE_MC ||
+      req.fw_size_bytes == 0U ||
+      req.fw_size_bytes != req.trailer.payload_len ||
+      boot_verify_trailer_struct(&req.trailer, BOARD_ID_MC_AT32F435, MC_MAX_APP_SIZE) != 0)
+  {
+    boot_ota_release_writer(BOOT_WRITER_UART2);
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  s_ota.stay_in_boot = 1U;
+  s_ota.state = MC_OTA_STATE_ERASED_READY;
+  s_ota.last_error = 0U;
+  s_ota.expected_size = req.fw_size_bytes;
+  s_ota.expected_crc32 = req.fw_crc32;
+  s_ota.next_offset = 0U;
+  s_ota.erased_end_addr = FLASH_APP_ADDR;
+  send_ack(p_req);
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  按需擦除 2KB 扇区并向 MC App 分区写入与回读校验数据块
+  */
+static int write_mc_app_flash_chunk(uint32_t offset,
+                                    const uint8_t *p_data,
+                                    uint32_t data_len)
+{
+  uint32_t target_addr = FLASH_APP_ADDR + offset;
+  uint32_t end_addr = target_addr + data_len;
+
+#ifndef HOST_UNIT_TEST
+  flash_unlock();
+  while (s_ota.erased_end_addr < end_addr)
+  {
+    if (flash_sector_erase(s_ota.erased_end_addr) != FLASH_OPERATE_DONE)
+    {
+      flash_lock();
+      return -1;
+    }
+    s_ota.erased_end_addr += MC_FLASH_SECTOR_SIZE;
+  }
+  for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < data_len; i++)
+  {
+    if (flash_byte_program(target_addr + i, p_data[i]) != FLASH_OPERATE_DONE ||
+        *(volatile uint8_t *)(target_addr + i) != p_data[i])
+    {
+      flash_lock();
+      return -2;
+    }
+  }
+  flash_lock();
+  return 0;
+#else
+  while (s_ota.erased_end_addr < end_addr)
+  {
+    if (host_mock_flash_erase_sector(s_ota.erased_end_addr) != 0)

+/**
+  * @brief  校验 0x21 CMD_OTA_DATA 的块长度、偏移边界与内层 CRC16
+  */
+static uint8_t validate_ota_data_bounds(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req,
+                                        const uint8_t *p_payload,
+                                        minimc_payload_ota_data_hdr_t *p_dh)
+{
+  if (s_ota.state != MC_OTA_STATE_ERASED_READY && s_ota.state != MC_OTA_STATE_FLASH_WRITING)
+  {
+    return MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED;
+  }
+  if (p_payload == NULL || p_req->payload_len <= sizeof(minimc_payload_ota_data_hdr_t))
+  {
+    return MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED;
+  }
+  memcpy(p_dh, p_payload, sizeof(*p_dh));
+  uint16_t data_len = (uint16_t)(p_req->payload_len - sizeof(*p_dh));
+  if (p_dh->chunk_bytes == 0U || p_dh->chunk_bytes > CHUNK_MAX_SIZE || p_dh->chunk_bytes != data_len)
+  {
+    return MINIMC_ERR_MTU_EXCEEDED;
+  }
+  if (p_dh->offset > s_ota.expected_size || (uint32_t)data_len > (s_ota.expected_size - p_dh->offset))
+  {
+    return MINIMC_ERR_OTA_INVALID_OFFSET;
+  }
+  const uint8_t *p_data = &p_payload[sizeof(*p_dh)];
+  if (boot_crc16_ccitt(p_data, data_len) != p_dh->chunk_crc16)
+  {
+    return MINIMC_ERR_CRC_FAIL;
+  }
+  return 0U;
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x21 CMD_OTA_DATA (支持重传幂等与按扇区擦写回读校验)
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_ota_data(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req,
+                                const uint8_t *p_payload)
+{
+  minimc_payload_ota_data_hdr_t dh;
+  uint8_t err = validate_ota_data_bounds(p_req, p_payload, &dh);
+  if (err != 0U)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, err);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  /* 重传幂等：已写入块重传直接回复 ACK */
+  if (dh.offset < s_ota.next_offset && (dh.offset + dh.chunk_bytes) <= s_ota.next_offset)
+  {
+    send_ack(p_req);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (dh.offset != s_ota.next_offset)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_OTA_INVALID_OFFSET);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const uint8_t *p_data = &p_payload[sizeof(dh)];
+  int wrc = write_mc_app_flash_chunk(dh.offset, p_data, dh.chunk_bytes);
+  if (wrc != 0)
+  {
+    s_ota.state = MC_OTA_STATE_ERROR;
+    send_nack(p_req, (wrc == -1) ? MINIMC_ERR_OTA_ERASE_FAIL : MINIMC_ERR_OTA_WRITE_FAIL);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  s_ota.state = MC_OTA_STATE_FLASH_WRITING;
+  s_ota.next_offset += dh.chunk_bytes;
+  send_ack(p_req);
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x23 CMD_OTA_STATUS 请求并回复 8B 进度状态
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_ota_status(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req)
+{
+  if (p_req->payload_len != 0U)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+  minimc_payload_ota_status_t rsp;
+  rsp.ota_state = (uint8_t)s_ota.state;
+  rsp.error_code = s_ota.last_error;
+  rsp.cached_chunk0_bytes = 0U;
+  rsp.bytes_written = s_ota.next_offset;
+  send_minimc_response(p_req, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_STATUS, (const uint8_t *)&rsp, sizeof(rsp));
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  处理 0x22 CMD_OTA_FINISH (全镜像 IEEE CRC32 校验与安全跳转准备)
+  */
+static void handle_cmd_ota_finish(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_req,
+                                  const uint8_t *p_payload)
+{
+  if (p_payload == NULL || p_req->payload_len != sizeof(minimc_payload_ota_finish_t))
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
+    return;
+  }
+  minimc_payload_ota_finish_t fin;
+  memcpy(&fin, p_payload, sizeof(fin));
+
+  if (s_ota.state == MC_OTA_STATE_VERIFIED_COMMITTED && fin.fw_crc32 == s_ota.expected_crc32)
+  {
+    send_ack(p_req);
+    return;
+  }
+  if (s_ota.next_offset != s_ota.expected_size || s_ota.expected_size == 0U)
+  {
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_OTA_INVALID_OFFSET);
+    return;
+  }
+
+#ifndef HOST_UNIT_TEST
+  const uint8_t *p_flash = (const uint8_t *)FLASH_APP_ADDR;
+#else
+  const uint8_t *p_flash = host_mock_flash_ptr(FLASH_APP_ADDR);
+#endif
+  uint32_t calc_crc = boot_crc32_ieee(p_flash, s_ota.expected_size);
+  if (calc_crc != s_ota.expected_crc32 || calc_crc != fin.fw_crc32 || is_app_valid(FLASH_APP_ADDR) == 0U)
+  {
+    s_ota.state = MC_OTA_STATE_ERROR;
+    send_nack(p_req, MINIMC_ERR_OTA_CRC_MISMATCH);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  s_ota.state = MC_OTA_STATE_VERIFIED_COMMITTED;
+  boot_ota_release_writer(BOOT_WRITER_UART2);
+  send_ack(p_req);
+  if (fin.action_after_verify == 1U)
+  {
+    s_ota.pending_jump = 1U;
+  }
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  分发一帧已通过外层 CRC16 校验的 MiniMCProto v2.0 报文
+  */
+static void dispatch_valid_frame(const minimc_frame_hdr_t *p_hdr, const uint8_t *p_payload)
+{
+  /* 严格节点过滤：仅处理发往 MC(0x02) 的 V2 请求帧，绝不响应或转发 DST=0x03(TH) */
+  if (p_hdr->dst_id != MINIMC_NODE_MC)
+  {
+    return;
+  }
+  if ((p_hdr->flags & 0x0CU) != MINIMC_FLAG_VERSION_V2 ||
+      (p_hdr->flags & MINIMC_FLAG_IS_RESPONSE) != 0U)
+  {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  s_ota.rx_ok_count++;
+  switch (p_hdr->cmd_id)
+  {
+    case MINIMC_CMD_GET_VERSION:    handle_cmd_get_version(p_hdr); break;
+    case MINIMC_CMD_PING:           handle_cmd_ping(p_hdr, p_payload); break;
+    case MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL: handle_cmd_system_control(p_hdr, p_payload); break;
+    case MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START:      handle_cmd_ota_start(p_hdr, p_payload); break;
+    case MINIMC_CMD_OTA_DATA:       handle_cmd_ota_data(p_hdr, p_payload); break;
+    case MINIMC_CMD_OTA_FINISH:     handle_cmd_ota_finish(p_hdr, p_payload); break;
+    case MINIMC_CMD_OTA_STATUS:     handle_cmd_ota_status(p_hdr); break;
+    default:                        send_nack(p_hdr, MINIMC_ERR_UNKNOWN_CMD); break;
+  }
+}

+/**
+  * @brief  逐字节喂入 MiniMCProto v2.0 帧同步状态机
+  */
+static void feed_frame_byte(uint8_t byte)
+{
+  if (s_frame_idx == 0U)
+  {
+    if (byte == MINIMC_SOF_0) { s_frame_buf[s_frame_idx++] = byte; }
+    return;
+  }
+  if (s_frame_idx == 1U)
+  {
+    if (byte == MINIMC_SOF_1) { s_frame_buf[s_frame_idx++] = byte; }
+    else { s_frame_idx = (byte == MINIMC_SOF_0) ? 1U : 0U; s_frame_buf[0] = byte; }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  s_frame_buf[s_frame_idx++] = byte;
+  if (s_frame_idx == MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE)
+  {
+    uint16_t payload_len = (uint16_t)s_frame_buf[10] | ((uint16_t)s_frame_buf[11] << 8U);
+    if (payload_len > MINIMC_MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE) { s_frame_idx = 0U; return; }
+    s_expected_frame_len = (uint16_t)(MINIMC_FRAME_OVERHEAD + payload_len);
+  }
+  else if (s_frame_idx > MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE && s_frame_idx >= s_expected_frame_len)
+  {
+    uint16_t total_len = s_expected_frame_len;
+    s_frame_idx = 0U;
+    s_expected_frame_len = 0U;
+    uint16_t rx_crc = (uint16_t)s_frame_buf[total_len - 2U] |
+                      ((uint16_t)s_frame_buf[total_len - 1U] << 8U);
+    if (boot_crc16_ccitt(s_frame_buf, (uint32_t)(total_len - 2U)) != rx_crc)
+    {
+      s_ota.rx_crc_err_count++;
+      return;
+    }
+    minimc_frame_hdr_t hdr;
+    memcpy(&hdr, s_frame_buf, MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE);
+    dispatch_valid_frame(&hdr, &s_frame_buf[MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE]);
+  }
+}

+    MINIMC_CMD_OTA_DATA, MINIMC_DEFAULT_HOP_LIMIT, 0U, seq, pay_len
+  };
+  minimc_payload_ota_data_hdr_t dh;
+  dh.offset = offset;
+  dh.chunk_bytes = data_len;
+  dh.chunk_crc16 = boot_crc16_ccitt(p_data, data_len);
+
+  uint8_t raw[MINIMC_MAX_FRAME_SIZE];
+  memcpy(raw, &hdr, MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE);
+  memcpy(&raw[MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE], &dh, sizeof(dh));
+  memcpy(&raw[MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE + sizeof(dh)], p_data, data_len);
+  uint16_t crc = boot_crc16_ccitt(raw, (uint32_t)(MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE + pay_len));
+  raw[MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE + pay_len] = (uint8_t)(crc & 0xFFU);
+  raw[MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE + pay_len + 1U] = (uint8_t)((crc >> 8U) & 0xFFU);
+
+  s_last_tx_len = 0U;
+  for (uint16_t i = 0U; i < (uint16_t)(MINIMC_FRAME_OVERHEAD + pay_len); i++)
+  {
+    boot_uart_ota_rx_byte_isr(raw[i]);
+  }
+  boot_uart_ota_poll();
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  生成合法测试镜像与 128B ATSG Trailer
+  */
+static void build_mc_image_and_trailer(uint8_t *p_img,
+                                       uint32_t len,
+                                       fw_trailer_t *p_tr,
+                                       uint32_t *p_crc)
+{
+  for (uint32_t i = 0U; i < len; i++)
+  {
+    p_img[i] = (uint8_t)((i * 37U + 11U) & 0xFFU);
+  }
+  uint32_t msp = 0x20040000UL;
+  uint32_t pc = 0x08020101UL;
+  memcpy(&p_img[0], &msp, 4U);
+  memcpy(&p_img[4], &pc, 4U);
+
+  memset(p_tr, 0, sizeof(*p_tr));
+  p_tr->magic = TRAILER_MAGIC_ATSG;
+  p_tr->struct_ver = TRAILER_STRUCT_VER_V1;
+  p_tr->board_id = BOARD_ID_MC_AT32F435;
+  p_tr->fw_version = 0x01020300UL;
+  p_tr->payload_len = len;
+  p_tr->trailer_crc32 = boot_crc32_ieee((const uint8_t *)p_tr, TRAILER_HEADER_CRC_SIZE);
+  *p_crc = boot_crc32_ieee(p_img, len);
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  测试 UPG2 驻留魔数、0x01/0x02、0x03/0x04、0x1D 及 DST=0x03 严格静默丢弃
+  */
+static void test_magic_info_heartbeat_and_dst_filter(void)
+{
+  s_sim_magic = BOOT_MC_UPGRADE_MAGIC_VAL;
+  boot_uart_ota_init();
+  require_true(s_sim_magic == 0UL, "UPG2 magic must be cleared on init");
+  require_true(boot_uart_ota_should_stay_in_boot() == 1U, "UPG2 magic sets stay_in_boot");
+  uint32_t bid1 = boot_uart_ota_get_boot_id();
+
+  boot_uart_ota_init();
+  uint32_t bid2 = boot_uart_ota_get_boot_id();
+  require_true(bid1 != 0U && bid2 != 0U && bid1 != bid2, "dynamic boot_id changes across init");
+
+  /* DST=0x03 (TH) 必须静默忽略，零字节发送 */
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_TH, MINIMC_CMD_GET_VERSION, 1U, NULL);
+  require_true(s_last_tx_len == 0U, "DST=0x03 must be ignored by MC Bootloader");
+
+  /* 0x01 -> 0x02 CMD_VERSION_REPORT */
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_GET_VERSION, 2U, NULL);
+  require_true(s_last_tx_len == 30U && s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_VERSION_REPORT, "0x02 VERSION_REPORT");
+  minimc_payload_version_report_t vrep;
+  memcpy(&vrep, &s_last_tx[12], sizeof(vrep));
+  require_true(vrep.capability_flags == MC_BOOT_CAPABILITY_FLAGS && vrep.boot_id == bid2, "MC capability_flags == 0xC0080435");
+
+  /* 0x03 -> 0x04 CMD_PONG */
+  uint32_t tok = 0xCAFEBABEUL;
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_PING, 3U, &tok);
+  require_true(s_last_tx_len == 26U && s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_PONG, "0x04 PONG");
+
+  /* 0x1D JumpToBootloader(2) & Reboot(1) */
+  minimc_payload_sys_ctrl_t sc_boot = {2U, 1U, 10U};
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 4U, &sc_boot);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK && boot_uart_ota_should_stay_in_boot() == 1U, "0x1D stay in boot");
+  minimc_payload_sys_ctrl_t sc_reboot = {1U, 1U, 10U};
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL, 5U, &sc_reboot);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK && s_reset_count == 1U, "0x1D reboot");
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  测试单写者互斥锁 (USB Host vs USART2) 与 0x20 擦除前零擦除负例门禁及恢复
+  */
+static void test_single_writer_mutex_and_zero_erase_admission(void)
+{
+  uint8_t img[1024];
+  fw_trailer_t tr;
+  uint32_t crc = 0U;
+  build_mc_image_and_trailer(img, sizeof(img), &tr, &crc);
+  boot_uart_ota_init();
+  s_erase_count = 0U;
+
+  minimc_payload_ota_start_t req;
+  memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
+  req.target_device = MINIMC_NODE_MC;
+  req.target_component = 1U;
+  req.fw_size_bytes = sizeof(img);
+  req.fw_crc32 = crc;
+  req.trailer = tr;
+
+  /* 1. USB 升级占用时，USART2 0x20 必须返回 NACK 0x05 (DEVICE_BUSY) 且零擦除 */
+  g_upgrade_in_progress = 1U;
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START, 10U, &req);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY, "USB busy -> NACK 0x05");
+  require_true(s_erase_count == 0U, "USB busy zero erase");
+  g_upgrade_in_progress = 0U;
+
+  /* 2. 917,505B (896KB + 1B) 超限必须返回 NACK 0x14 (OTA_IMAGE_OVERSIZE) 且零擦除 */
+  req.fw_size_bytes = MC_MAX_APP_SIZE + 1U;
+  req.trailer = tr;
+  req.trailer.payload_len = MC_MAX_APP_SIZE + 1U;
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START, 11U, &req);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_OTA_IMAGE_OVERSIZE && s_erase_count == 0U, "oversize 917505B zero erase");
+
+  /* 3. 错板 (TH 0x42300001) 与坏 trailer_crc32 必须返回 NACK 0x06 且零擦除，且状态保持 IDLE 并可恢复 */
+  req.fw_size_bytes = sizeof(img);
+  req.trailer = tr;
+  req.trailer.board_id = BOARD_ID_TH_AT32F423;
+  req.trailer.trailer_crc32 = boot_crc32_ieee((const uint8_t *)&req.trailer, TRAILER_HEADER_CRC_SIZE);
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START, 12U, &req);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED && s_erase_count == 0U, "wrong board zero erase");
+
+  req.trailer = tr;
+  req.trailer.trailer_crc32 ^= 0xDEADBEEFUL;
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START, 13U, &req);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED && s_erase_count == 0U, "bad trailer_crc32 zero erase");
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_STATUS, 14U, NULL);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_OTA_STATUS && s_last_tx[12] == 0U, "state stays IDLE and recovers");
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  测试完整 0x20 -> 0x21 (含重传幂等与错位 0x13) -> 0x23 -> 0x22 升级与校验跳转
+  */
+static void test_full_ota_flow_and_crc_verification(void)
+{
+  uint8_t img[1024];
+  fw_trailer_t tr;
+  uint32_t crc = 0U;
+  build_mc_image_and_trailer(img, sizeof(img), &tr, &crc);
+  memset(s_sim_flash, 0xAA, sizeof(s_sim_flash));
+  boot_uart_ota_init();
+  s_erase_count = 0U;
+  s_jump_count = 0U;
+
+  minimc_payload_ota_start_t req;
+  memset(&req, 0, sizeof(req));
+  req.target_device = MINIMC_NODE_MC;
+  req.target_component = 1U;
+  req.fw_size_bytes = sizeof(img);
+  req.fw_crc32 = crc;
+  req.trailer = tr;
+
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_START, 20U, &req);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK && s_erase_count == 0U, "0x20 ACK before sector write");
+  require_true(boot_ota_acquire_writer(BOOT_WRITER_USB) == 0U, "USB blocked while UART2 holds writer");
+
+  /* 错位 offset=512 必须返回 NACK 0x13 (OTA_INVALID_OFFSET) */
+  send_ota_data_chunk(21U, 512U, &img[512]);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_NACK && s_last_tx[12] == MINIMC_ERR_OTA_INVALID_OFFSET, "offset mismatch 0x13");
+
+  /* 写入 Chunk 0 (0..512) -> 触发首个 2KB 扇区擦除，重传 Chunk 0 幂等返回 ACK */
+  send_ota_data_chunk(22U, 0U, &img[0]);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK && s_erase_count == 1U, "Chunk 0 ACK & 1 sector erased");
+  send_ota_data_chunk(23U, 0U, &img[0]);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK && s_erase_count == 1U, "Chunk 0 retransmit idempotent");
+
+  /* 写入 Chunk 1 (512..1024) 并查询 0x23 STATUS */
+  send_ota_data_chunk(24U, 512U, &img[512]);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK, "Chunk 1 ACK");
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_STATUS, 25U, NULL);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_OTA_STATUS && s_last_tx_len == 22U, "0x23 status 8B payload");
+
+  /* 0x22 CMD_OTA_FINISH 校验通过并触发 jump_to_app(0x08020000) */
+  minimc_payload_ota_finish_t fin_req = {crc, 1U, {0U, 0U, 0U}};
+  send_minimc_frame(MINIMC_NODE_MC, MINIMC_CMD_OTA_FINISH, 26U, &fin_req);
+  require_true(s_last_tx[5] == MINIMC_CMD_ACK && s_jump_count == 1U && s_last_jump_addr == FLASH_APP_ADDR, "0x22 ACK and jump");
+  require_true(memcmp(s_sim_flash, img, sizeof(img)) == 0, "Flash image matches 100%");
+}
+
+/**
+  * @brief  测试主入口
+  */
+int main(void)
+{
+  test_magic_info_heartbeat_and_dst_filter();
+  test_single_writer_mutex_and_zero_erase_admission();
+  test_full_ota_flow_and_crc_verification();
+  printf("[PASS] test_mc_boot_ota: all MC Bootloader MiniMCProto v2.0 tests passed!\n");
+  return 0;
+}
